items.title: Leon Rene Interview, 1979-05-07
items.q: I think they got the other Boogie Wiggy, Boogie Wiggy Plow, and he got his job back.

ctx.x: A dollar and a half. Two and a half. And I was, I was glad to get that. And of course there was no one to take my place down at the other, I think they got the other Boogie Wiggy, Boogie Wiggy Plow, and he got his job back. And they never did like him, because he played with, when they played the scenes of the comedy, you know, he was all right with the Boogie Wiggy. Then they went into the love scenes, where when they played love scenes, it's supposed to be sweet and he was playing Boogie Wiggy all the time.
